deltas=[]

        rows=[p[0] for p in ypx]; cols=[p[1] for p in ypx]

        print('L1 yellow center approx',(cr,cc),'Y count',len(ypx))
        # gem centers in L1 before: find c-blocks with colored center

# execute plan: (30,0) -> (12,21): UPx6, RIGHTx7

Lc=current_frame.ascii.splitlines()
W=[(r,c) for r in range(64) for c in range(64) if Lc[r][c]=='W']
print('W:',W)
for g in [(3,21),(9,27),(12,12)]:
    print(g,'r' if Lc[g[0]][g[1]]=='r' else 'collected')
print({k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ('board_changed','no_impact','level_completed','done')})
